desc: Skill Shop list (245 x 16): spells and generic evilities that can be bought/learned. kind 2 = magic.dat spell (entries 2000-2046: Fire..Tera, Heal, buffs, debuffs, ailments, Geo), kind 1 = Skill.dat evility (entries 4001-4197, the generic 4000-4324 shop evilities).

fields.name: entry_id
fields.desc: list entry id (2000+n for spells, 4001+n for evilities; equals the evility id up to 4033). Not an item.dat id

fields.name: shop_rank
fields.desc: 0..4; tier within a family (Fire 0, Mega 1.. Tera 4; evilities 0-4). Probably shop rank needed to unlock
